The season began on 17 July 2026.{{cite web | last=Srbija | first=Euronews | title=Večiti derbi odlučio titulu: Crvena zvezda deveti put zaredom šampion Srbije | website=Euronews.rs | date=2026-04-27 | url=https://www.euronews.rs/sport/fudbal/220988/crvena-zvezda-osvojila-37-titulu-savladavsi-partizan/vest | language=sr | access-date=2026-05-17}} The title holder is [[Red Star Belgrade]]. The league features two promoted clubs, [[FK Zemun|Zemun]] and [[FK Mačva Šabac|Mačva]].https://www.superliga.rs/ ==Overview== The Serbian SuperLiga will be reduced from 14 to 12 teams from 2027–28 onwards. Thus for this season, four teams will automatically be relegated to next season's [[Serbian First League]].{{cite web | title=Zvanično: Liga se smanjuje, privremeno na 14, pa za stalno na 12 |
